caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a central area filled with intricate, symmetrical floral and decorative motifs in red, blue, and black on a light pink or beige background. The upper portion has a patterned band of large, stylized red flowers with black leaves and small blue accents. Below, there are two mirrored sections: one on the left with a blue and black bird surrounded by floral elements, and another section on the right with a red and black bird amid similar foliage. At the left side, a vertical border of alternating diamond shapes in red, black, and blue frames the composition, with a parallel border of stitched or painted blue and red lines running lengthwise. Inside these sections, a square area contains the name "EMANUEL ETTINGER ARONSBURG" and the date "1840," with "EMANUEL" arranged in three lines and the rest of the name and date split among four lines, some text in blue, some in red, and some in black. The lower horizontal border showcases a sequence of rhombus shapes in black and blue with inner diamond details. The entire artwork is enclosed within a thin red border, and a small inscription reading "Grief velds" is located at the bottom right corner.
title: Coverlet
